note: Dice sets for the FUMBBL Reborn action log. A new color set = same style/seeds, different die_color/symbol_color.
style_template: A single square game die face, perfectly flat top-down view, the die face filling the ENTIRE frame edge to edge as a perfect square with slightly rounded corners. The die background is a solid {die_color}. Flat clean vector game-art style, crisp uniform edges, no gradients, no bevel, no 3D perspective, no texture noise, no shadow. In the exact center of the die face: a white circular badge about 70% of the face size, whose rim has many small irregular jagged spikes around the whole circle (a round white frame with a torn, spiky edge, like the official Games Workshop Blood Bowl block dice badge). Inside the white badge, perfectly centered, one bold {symbol_color} symbol, well inside the badge edge: {symbol}. Nothing else: no text, no numbers, no letters, no watermark, no border frame around the square.
